htmlcss_int_lesson_1:slide:0.title: What is Flexbox? 📦
htmlcss_int_lesson_1:slide:0.content:
Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout method for rows or columns.

Key properties:
• display: flex
• justify-content (main axis)
• align-items (cross axis)
• flex-direction

htmlcss_int_lesson_1:slide:1.title: Flexbox Axes 🎯
htmlcss_int_lesson_1:slide:1.content:
Two axes in flexbox:

**Main Axis** - Direction items flow (row/column)
• justify-content controls this

**Cross Axis** - Perpendicular to main
• align-items controls this

htmlcss_int_lesson_1:question:0.prompt: Which property centers on main axis?

htmlcss_int_lesson_1:question:1.explanation: column changes the main axis to vertical, stacking items top to bottom.

htmlcss_int_lesson_1:question:2.explanation: flex: 1 means flex-grow: 1, allowing the item to grow and fill available space.

options.htmlcss_int_lesson_1:question:2:option:1: Item takes equal share of space

htmlcss_int_lesson_2:slide:0.title: CSS Grid 🔲
htmlcss_int_lesson_2:slide:0.content:
CSS Grid creates layouts with rows AND columns.

Key properties:
• grid-template-columns
• grid-template-rows
• gap
• fr unit (fraction)

htmlcss_int_lesson_2:slide:1.title: Grid vs Flexbox 🆚
htmlcss_int_lesson_2:slide:1.content:
When to use which:

**Grid:** 2D layouts (rows AND columns)
• Page layouts
• Card grids
• Complex structures

**Flexbox:** 1D layouts (row OR column)
• Navigation bars
• Centering
• Single row/column

htmlcss_int_lesson_2:question:0.explanation: fr is a fraction unit for available space.

htmlcss_int_lesson_2:question:1.prompt: What does auto-fit do in repeat()?
htmlcss_int_lesson_2:question:1.explanation: auto-fit creates as many columns as can fit in the available space.

options.htmlcss_int_lesson_2:question:1:option:1: Fills row with as many columns as fit

htmlcss_int_lesson_2:question:2.explanation: Define both columns and rows with grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows.

htmlcss_int_lesson_5:slide:0.title: Responsive Design 📱
htmlcss_int_lesson_5:slide:0.content:
Apply different styles based on screen size.

Breakpoints:
• Mobile: < 768px
• Tablet: 768px - 1024px
• Desktop: > 1024px

htmlcss_int_lesson_5:slide:1.content: Start with mobile, add desktop styles.
